ask.full_name: What is your full name, exactly as on your 10th marksheet?
ask.dob: What is your date of birth?
ask.district: Which district do you live in?
ask.category: Which category do you belong to — Open, OBC, SC, ST, VJ/NT, SBC, SEBC or EWS?
ask.annual_family_income: Roughly what is your family's total yearly income?
ask.ssc_year: In which year did you pass 10th (SSC)?
ask.ssc_percentage: What percentage did you get in 10th?
ask.hsc_year: In which year did you pass 12th (HSC)?
ask.hsc_percentage: What percentage did you get in 12th?
ask.current_course: Which course are you studying now?
ask.current_year: Which year of the course are you in?
why.full_name: Forms need your name exactly as on your documents, so they can be matched later.
why.dob: Some schemes have an age limit, and documents are matched by date of birth.
why.gender: Forms ask for it, and some scholarships are only for girls.
why.district: Your district decides your local office, and some schemes depend on where you live.
why.category: Many scholarships depend on category. I only use it to check the official rules.
why.annual_family_income: Most scholarships have a family income limit, checked against your income certificate.
why.ssc_year: Forms ask for your 10th details, and some check the gap between years.
why.ssc_percentage: Some schemes need a minimum 10th score.
why.hsc_year: Forms ask for your 12th details; a gap year may need a gap certificate.
why.hsc_percentage: Some schemes need a minimum 12th score.
why.current_course: Scholarships depend on the course type — degree, diploma or professional.
why.current_year: Some scholarships are for first-year students; renewals work differently.
why._generic: I ask so the form can be filled correctly. You can skip anything you don't want to share.
why._source: Asked once for your Aster profile and reused across forms. Each scheme's exact rules are checked later against official sources.
llm_unavailable: Sorry, I can't think right now — my connection is down. Your cards and profile still work. Please try again in a minute.
